description: This file provides a utility function for web scraping using Playwright with an emphasis on fetching dynamically generated content from JavaScript-heavy pages. It encapsulates the setup of a headless Chromium browser, handles browser and page lifecycle events, and offers a single asynchronous function to retrieve page HTML after DOM content has loaded, optimized for use with BeautifulSoup.

methods.name: Optional[str] fetch_with_playwright( url: str, timeout_seconds: int = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, store_name: str = "unknown" )
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a web page with Playwright, rendering it and returning the HTML content after DOM content is loaded, with configurable timeout and store name for logging.

ctags.name: fetch_with_playwright
ctags.signature: ( url: str, timeout_seconds: int = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, store_name: str = "unknown" )
